worktree-one-fetch-order.mutation: replace the sole action/stop sequence and withhold its guard reference

details.raw:
```bash
git fetch origin main
git fetch origin mybr
remote_oid=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)

# 拓扑检查：右侧>0 表示 mybr 落后，需先并入
right_count=$(git rev-list --left-right --count mybr...$remote_oid 2>/dev/null | cut -f2)
if [ "$right_count" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "mybr 落后于 origin/main，需先并入"
  exit 1
fi

git rebase origin/main
git push --force-with-lease=mybr:$remote_oid
git fetch origin mybr
```

失效证据：
- 工作区/暂存区有未提交改动（status --porcelain 非空）
- 分支无上游配置（rev-parse @{u} 失败）
- 本地 tip 未全推送（rev-list @{u}...HEAD 右侧 > 0）
- 分支落后于目标（merge-base --is-ancestor 返回 1）
- 拓扑检查失败（rev-list mybr...$remote_oid 右侧 > 0）

```bash
# 刷新目标
git fetch origin

# 只 fetch 一次 mybr，选择不更新 tracking ref 的形式
git fetch origin mybr

# 立刻保存 $remote_oid
remote_oid=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)

# 完整拓扑命令和右侧非 0 的停止注释
right_count=$(git rev-list --left-right --count mybr...$remote_oid | awk '{print $2}')
[ "$right_count" -eq 0 ] || { echo "error: right count is non-zero ($right_count)"; exit 1; }

# rebase
git rebase origin/main mybr

# 显式 OID lease push
git push --force-with-lease=mybr:$remote_oid origin mybr

# push 后 fetch
git fetch origin mybr
```

失效证据（需重审）：评审线程、approval、mergeable 状态、CI 状态、commit hash、行内评论锚点

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# 刷新目标
git fetch origin

# 钉住目标 SHA
TARGET=$(git rev-parse origin/main)

# 钉住更新前的分支 tip
BRANCH_OLD=$(git rev-parse mybr)

# 计算旧分叉点
OLD_BASE=$(git merge-base "$TARGET" "$BRANCH_OLD")

# 检查落后状态
if git merge-base --is-ancestor "$TARGET" "$BRANCH_OLD"; then
    echo "分支已含该目标，无需更新"
elif [ $? -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "分支落后，需先更新到 $TARGET"
else
    echo "merge-base 出错（非 0/1），先排查别当落后处理"
    exit 1
fi

# 只 fetch 一次 mybr（不更新 tracking ref）
git fetch origin mybr

# 立刻保存 remote_oid
remote_oid=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)

# 完整拓扑命令：右侧非 0 = 并入、禁 rebase
git rev-list --left-right --count mybr...$remote_oid 2>/dev/null

# rebase 到 origin/main
git rebase origin/main

# 显式 OID lease push
git push --force-with-lease=mybr:$remote_oid origin mybr

# push 后 fetch
git fetch origin mybr
```

失效证据：无上游 | 本地领先 | 落地对象不符 | 分支已含该目标 | 分支落后 | merge-base 出错（非 0/1） | 出现意外删除 | 出现目标已修复内容被改回旧值

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e

git fetch origin

git fetch origin mybr
remote_oid=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)

TARGET=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
BRANCH_OLD=$(git rev-parse mybr)
OLD_BASE=$(git merge-base "$TARGET" "$BRANCH_OLD")

if git merge-base --is-ancestor "$TARGET" "$BRANCH_OLD"; then
  echo "分支已含该目标，无需更新"
  exit 0
elif [ $? -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "分支落后，进行 rebase"
fi

git rev-list --left-right --count @{u}...HEAD 2>/dev/null || true

git rebase origin/main

git push --force-with-lease=mybr:"$remote_oid" origin mybr

git fetch origin mybr
```
